test_title: RRB NTPC CBT-I Official Paper (Held On: 9 Mar 2021 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following statements is not about Netaji Subhas Chandra Bose?

options.text: He participated in the Non-cooperation Movement, 1921
He was member of the Constitution Drafting Committee.
He founded the Indian National Army (INA).

solution:
The correct answer is __**He was a member of the Constitution Drafting Committee**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **He was a member of the Constitution Drafting Committee**:

 
 
• This statement is **not true**.
 
• The Constitution Drafting Committee was formed in 1947, and while Bose was a prominent leader in the Indian independence movement,
 
• he was not a member of this committee, as he was not in India during its formation.
 
 
 
• Constitution Drafting Committee
 
 
• The committee was chaired by **Dr. B.R. Ambedkar**, who is often referred to as the **Father of the Indian Constitution**. 
 
• It was established to draft a constitution for independent India, ensuring a framework for governance and the protection of individual rights.
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ** He participated in the Non-cooperation Movement, 1921**:

 
 
• This statement is **true**.
 
• Subhas Chandra Bose actively participated in the Non-cooperation Movement led by Mahatma Gandhi.
 
 
 
• **He founded the Indian National Army (INA):**
 
 
• This statement is true.
 
• Bose was instrumental in the formation of the Indian National Army during World War II to fight for India's independence.
 
 
 
• **He was deported to Mandalay: **
 
 
• This statement is true. Bose was arrested and interned in Mandalay (Burma) by the British authorities.
